description:
Adapt the keyed-comprehension hoister for vnode-emitting bodies. Today's hoister rewrites {key, var_map, entry_fn} PLV.Comprehension shapes; under vnode IR the entry fn just returns a vnode tuple, so the hoister gets simpler — but the substantive job (move register_event_handler / nested component calls out of the lazy entry fn into the surrounding for-body) still applies.

Non-keyed :for emits {:fragment, [...children]}; keyed :for+:key on a component emits a list of {:component, mod, props, key} tuples wrapped in {:fragment, ...}.

## Files
- lib/filament/vnode_engine.ex
- lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (hoist_comprehension_handlers, inject_key_into_for, rewrite_component_calls_to_keyed)

## Acceptance
- {for x <- xs do}<Item .../>{end} emits {:fragment, [{:component, Item, %{}, nil}, ...]}.
- :for + :key emits the same with stable key fields.
- Re-render with reordered list preserves fiber identity by key (existing keyed-comprehension reconciler tests pass).
title: Phase 1.4.3: :for and :for+:key comprehensions emit fragment/keyed-list vnodes
